description: This Java class 'InputContentFile' extends 'StaticContentFile' and implements 'Serializable'. It models a content file with an associated input stream, providing getter and setter methods for the file data.

classes.name: InputContentFile
classes.description: A Java class representing an input content file, with a serializable input stream, extending StaticContentFile.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the InputStream representing the content of the file.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the InputStream representing the content of the file.
